question: Contá los ensayos de fase 3 o fase 2/3 que prueban al menos un fármaco que actúa sobre el gen EGFR.

attempts.query:
WITH farmacos AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.pref_name
  FROM chembl.drug_mechanism dm
  JOIN chembl.target_components tc ON tc.target_chembl_id = dm.target_chembl_id
  JOIN chembl.molecule_dictionary m ON m.chembl_id = COALESCE(dm.parent_chembl_id, dm.chembl_id)
  WHERE tc.gene_symbol = 'EGFR' AND m.pref_name IS NOT NULL
),
nombres AS (
  SELECT i.nct_id, lower(i.name) AS nombre FROM aact.interventions i
  UNION
  SELECT o.nct_id, lower(o.name) FROM aact.intervention_other_names o
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
JOIN nombres n ON n.nct_id = s.nct_id
JOIN farmacos f ON n.nombre LIKE '%' || lower(f.pref_name) || '%'
WHERE s.phase IN ('PHASE3', 'PHASE2/PHASE3')
